en.description:
Play Go against a powerful AI — entirely offline. No internet, no accounts, no subscriptions. Just you and the board.

Offline Go runs KataGo, one of the world's strongest Go engines, directly on your device using Apple's Neural Engine. Every move is computed locally with a full neural network (b20c256), giving you a serious opponent that works anywhere — on a plane, in the subway, or off the grid.

7 difficulty levels to match any skill level:

Mochi — Very forgiving, perfect for learning the basics
Tanuki — Casual play with room to breathe
Kitsune — Balanced, moderate-strength opponent
Fukuro — Strong play with few mistakes
Tora — Very strong, minimal errors
Ryuu — Expert-level pure neural network play
Kami — Master-level with Monte Carlo Tree Search
Features:

Fully offline — no internet connection required, ever
Powered by KataGo neural networks via CoreML
Real-time move probability visualization
Win rate graph tracks your position throughout the game
Territory scoring with Japanese rules
Move history with full game replay
Game history to review past matches
Undo support
Multiple animated background themes
Runs on iPhone and iPad, and now Apple Watch!
Privacy first. No data collection, no analytics, no tracking. Everything stays on your device.
en.releaseNotes: Fixed missing NN - stronger opponents will play much stronger now
